name: Boku no Maman Sagashi ~Mama o Tazunetara... 8nin no Kyonyuu Tsuma Deshita~
original_name: ボクのママン捜し ～ママをたずねたら…8人の巨乳妻でした～
source: A woman reveals to a boy that she may not be his real mother and that there are eight potential mother candidates he must meet to find his true mother. He is upset and believes that his current mother, Yuka, is the only one he needs. The search for his true mother begins.
translation: 一个女人向一个男孩透露，她可能不是他的亲生母亲，他必须去见八位候选母亲才能找到自己的亲生母亲。他很难过，认为现在的母亲由香就是他唯一需要的。寻找亲生母亲之旅就此开始。
